title: Power BI Failures by Report
dataSources: Power BI admin refreshes (`powerbi:admin:refreshes`), admin API (`powerbi:admin:api`), gateway logs, and capacity metrics.
app: Power BI activity events from the Microsoft 365 / Purview audit log and the Power BI Admin & Fabric Capacity Metrics APIs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:admin:api activity="*Failed*" OR result="Failure"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by report_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Power BI failures grouped by report so operators immediately see which specific reports are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Power BI is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Power BI failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical reports.
visualization: Table of report by failure count and last failure time.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities / audit log

grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Power BI are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
